title: Bearings
seo_title: Bearings – SSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Read and draw three-figure bearings; find back bearings; solve problems on bearings and distances. (summary of the NERDC SSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 1 maths worksheets on bearings: three-figure bearings, compass directions, back bearings and distance problems. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Stand at the first place, face north, and turn clockwise to the second place.
  • Write the angle with three figures: 9° is 009°.
  • Back bearing = bearing ± 180°.

Examples

Example

Bearing of B from A is 060°

060° + 180°

Answer: Bearing of A from B = 240°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Measuring anticlockwiseBearings are clockwise.
Starting from the wrong point“From A” means stand at A.
Writing 45° instead of 045°Use three figures.
